title: Census ACS 2020-2024 five-year state median household income with margin of error
limitations: Five-year ACS estimate pools survey responses for 2020–2024 and is expressed in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars.
B19013_001M is an ACS margin of error, not a standard deviation or an independent statistic.
Data API requires a Census API key for live acquisition, which must remain a workflow secret.
Missing and suppressed estimates are never silently replaced by zeros.
Longitudinal comparisons with overlapping ACS five-year periods require additional statistical care.
